representation_fit.evidence: Primary representation is a directed node-link dependency graph (source/index.html:38 SVG #graph) with 44 typed nodes and 68 typed edges as first-class content (source/data.js:10-149; header '44 节点 68 关系 5 类型' in both screenshots), edge kinds 同步调用/数据读写/事件 rendered distinctly (source/app.js:27-32; legend in screenshots). Matches the brief's relational-web bundle: many, high relationality, medium hierarchy via hop-radius (app.js:56-68 BFS + radius control), no spatial/comparison facets forced in.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen at 1280x860 and 1440x900 is dominated by the follow-relations task: graph canvas ~72% of viewport with default focus 订单服务, follow-path bar '跟随路径: 订单服务' pinned at top, and right panel headed by '影响 · 谁依赖它' and '依赖 · 它依赖谁' lists (source/app.js:391,396) plus impact narrative '若「订单服务」不可用，半径 1 跳 内 2 个节点受影响…'. Dependencies/influence-following is the default state, not a mode.

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: screen self-explains within seconds — title+tagline '星脉 · 服务关系图谱 / 依赖可查 · 影响可追 · 全局恒在' (index.html:6,14-15), legend states arrow semantics '箭头指向被依赖方，影响沿箭头反向传播' (index.html:57), plain-language impact sentence in panel, node-type counts in legend. Minor deduction considered for 12px dim background labels (styles.css:135-137), but focus+panel structure is immediately legible in both viewports.

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object reachable in one step from initial state: click any graph node (app.js:455-460), click any relation row in panel (app.js:444-452), search with '/' shortcut (app.js:466-468, 496-519), or zero-step deep link #focus/#trail/#r (app.js:550-563). No modes, no page loads; backtracking via breadcrumb bar and 重置 (app.js:418-428, visible in screenshots).

context_loss.evidence: Structural preservation of global context is the explicit design center (the brief's seed): viewBox fitted once and never cropped — comment '整图恒在的关键：一次算好，永不裁剪' (app.js:137-147); unfocused nodes dim but stay visible (.node.dim opacity .13, styles.css:132); trail edges highlighted amber with flow animation (styles.css:124-129, visible in screenshots); breadcrumbs jump back to any station (app.js:418-424); badge '全局视图 · 跟随时整图恒在' (index.html:51) and crumb hint (index.html:33) state the guarantee; stats computed over the whole graph (app.js:358-364).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces (index.html:10-71): top bar with search+global stats, trail bar, graph canvas, legend card (type-filter chips, edge-kind legend, P0-only toggle), mode badge, 336px detail panel with radius segmented control and two stat cards. Each surface maps to a shape facet (filters→many, radius→hierarchy, legend→edge semantics), single main screen per constraint — but the permanent chrome is dense for a first view, slightly above minimal need.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails all three a11y checks: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail (measurement-summary.json:13-15). Corroborated in source: graph nodes are SVG <g> with click/mouse handlers only, no tabindex/keyboard access (app.js:194-214, 455-460); low-contrast tiers --muted #7c8a9c and --faint #55647a on #0a0e13 (styles.css:10-11,3) and default edge opacity .38 (styles.css:121); small targets — legend chips padding 2.5px 9px @11px (styles.css:173-176), radius seg buttons 4px 10px @11.5px (styles.css:242-244), 9.5px depth/kind chips (styles.css:282,285). Mitigations present: real <button> elements, labeled search input, Escape/'/' shortcuts (app.js:464-469).

frontend_rework.evidence: Receipt implies heavy rework: 6 of 7 checks failed (pass 1 / fail 6, target_invalid=false; measurement-summary.json:4-7) — layout.overflow=fail, text.truncation=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail plus the three a11y fails; only layout.responsive_collision=pass. Visible defects at the two captured viewports are mild (no gross breakage at 1280x860/1440x900; dim 12px background labels and 9.5-11px chips consistent with the size/truncation failures), so the score is carried up slightly from 1 by coherent visible rendering, but six failing checks each imply a fix pass.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '关系跟随不丢失全局上下文' is addressed both textually and structurally: '全局恒在' in title (index.html:6), empty-state text '整图始终可见，跟随不会丢失全局上下文' (app.js:350), badge and crumb-hint guarantees (index.html:33,51); enforcement via never-cropped fitted viewBox (app.js:137-147), dim-not-hide of non-focus nodes (styles.css:132), amber trail overlay on the live graph (screenshots show trail order→订单主库 while full 44-node graph stays visible), and breadcrumb return path (app.js:418-424).

defects_observed: Receipt: 6/7 browser checks failed (layout.overflow, text.truncation, a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size) with target_invalid=false — measurement-summary.json
Graph nodes are not keyboard-reachable (SVG <g> with pointer handlers only, no tabindex) — app.js:194-214, consistent with a11y.focus_order fail

Small interactive targets: 11px legend filter chips with 2.5px vertical padding (styles.css:173-176), 11.5px radius seg buttons (styles.css:242-244), 9.5px rel-kind/depth chips (styles.css:282,285) — consistent with a11y.target_size fail
Low-contrast text tiers (--muted #7c8a9c, --faint #55647a on #0a0e13 background, styles.css:3,10-11) and edges at opacity .38 (styles.css:121) — consistent with a11y.contrast fail
Background node labels render at 12px and are near-illegible at both 1280x860 and 1440x900 in the screenshots — consistent with type.min_projected_size fail
rel-name uses ellipsis truncation (styles.css:280) and fixed 336px panel with body overflow hidden (styles.css:27-28,201-204) — consistent with text.truncation and layout.overflow fails
scores.overall_note: This package is an exceptionally faithful answer to the cell brief: the primary representation is a real directed relationship graph where the relations themselves are the content (68 typed edges rendered and individually decoded by kind and direction, data.js:69-149), the follow-dependency/influence task is the dominant default state on the initial screen, and the acceptance seed '关系跟随不丢失全局上下文' is enforced structurally — a once-fitted never-cropped viewBox, dim-not-hide of non-focused nodes, an amber trail over the persisting whole graph, breadcrumbs, and one-step navigation including deep links — so representation_fit, primary_task_salience, time_to_understand, navigation_cost, context_loss, and acceptance_seed_coverage all score 5 on visible/structural evidence. The weaknesses are quality-attribute failures: the sanitized receipt shows 6 of 7 checks failing (only layout.responsive_collision passes), with all three a11y checks (contrast, focus order, target size) failed and corroborating source findings (no keyboard access to graph nodes, 9.5-11.5px targets, low-contrast muted tiers), and layout.overflow/text.truncation/type.min_projected_size failures that the two screenshots only mildly suggest — hence accessibility 2 and frontend_rework 2, while ui_surface_complexity is 4 because every permanent surface earns its place at the cost of dense chrome. Per the rubric, task_completion_time, information_retrieval_accuracy, and human_preference are not observable in blind review, and this model-judged preference over the initial screen is not a human-preference measurement.
